name: Plastic Supply of Maine
old_description: The place for all your plastic fabrication, distribution and routing needs!
about:
Plastic Supply of Maine operates from Biddeford, Maine, where it provides plastic fabrication, distribution, and precision machining services. The company, also known as Plastic Supply Inc. of Maine, does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials.

The shop offers custom fabrication, CNC routing, cut-to-size services, and on-site installation and fabrication. It maintains a full line of engineering plastic materials and sign materials, serving both fabrication and distribution needs. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

While the company highlights sign supplies among its offerings, it does not specify the industries or customer types it serves beyond that reference. Its capabilities suggest a focus on custom plastic parts and signage components.

The firm promotes itself as a single source for plastic fabrication, distribution, and routing, but does not articulate a specific founding mission or stated competitive advantage beyond the breadth of its in-house services.
